_meta.note: Curated (not extracted) — RHEL CLI dictionaries for the Command Decoder. Source: RHEL 9 man pages, paraphrased; verified 2026-08-23. Unknown flags must decode as unknown, never guessed.

verbs.status: show unit state + recent log lines (read-only)
verbs.start: start the unit now (does not survive reboot)
verbs.reload: re-read config without restart (if the unit supports it)
verbs.enable: wire the unit to start at boot
verbs.mask: block the unit from starting at all (symlink to /dev/null)
verbs.daemon-reload: re-read all unit files after edits
verbs.list-unit-files: list installed unit files and their enable state
verbs.cat: print the unit file including drop-ins

flags.--full: with edit: copy the whole unit instead of a drop-in

flags.-p: priority filter: emerg..debug (err = errors and worse)
flags.--vacuum-size: shrink journal to given size (deletes oldest)

flags.--zone: target a specific zone (default zone otherwise)
flags.--permanent: write saved config — does NOT change the running firewall until --reload
flags.--reload: replace runtime rules with the saved (permanent) config
flags.--runtime-to-permanent: save the current runtime rules as permanent

verbs.connection: profile view: show / add / modify / up / down (aliases: con, c)

verbs.remove: remove packages (watch the dependency list it proposes!)
verbs.check-update: list available updates (read-only, exit 100 = updates exist)

flags.-y: assume yes — skips the review; leave off for anything unread
flags.--enablerepo: enable a repo for this run
flags.--disablerepo: disable a repo for this run
flags.--downloadonly: fetch without installing (pre-stage in a window)

restorecon.desc: Reset SELinux file contexts to policy defaults

flags.-n: dry run — show what WOULD change
flags.-F: force full context reset (not just type)

semanage.desc: Manage persistent SELinux policy (contexts, ports, booleans)

verbs.fcontext: file-context rules: -a add, -d delete, -l list; pair with restorecon to apply
verbs.port: port-type rules: allow a service type on a nonstandard port
verbs.login: Linux user to SELinux user mappings

flags.-r: also resize the filesystem (the safe idiom — always use it)
flags.-l: size in extents; -l +100%FREE takes all free space

verbs.tracking: current clock offset and selected source (read-only)
verbs.sources: candidate time sources; * marks the selected one (read-only)
verbs.makestep: step the clock NOW instead of slewing — changes system time

logrotate.desc: Rotate, compress, and prune classic log files

flags.-d: debug dry run — show what WOULD happen, change nothing

flags.-R: recursive — pause before combining with broad paths
recursive — pause before combining with broad paths
